convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for MAMA_Optim indicator (not built-in), depends on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library for all trade execution logic including position opens/closes and money management

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required before calculation
TimeShiftSec - chart period in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for position open timing

other_exits: Opposite crossover signal triggers close of existing position (BuyPosClose when FAMA crosses below MAMA, SellPosClose when FAMA crosses above MAMA)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Negative MM values = fixed lot size (absolute value), positive MM values = share of deposit in deal (fractional sizing)

custom_logic_notes: Entry signal uses previous bar (index SignalBar+1) for confirmed crossover state and current signal bar (index SignalBar) for pre-crossover state: BUY_Open triggers when Ma1[1]>Ma2[1] (confirmed cross above on prev bar) AND Ma1[0]<Ma2[0] (was below on signal bar - detecting the crossover moment). SignalBar=1 means using bar 1 (last closed) and bar 2 for comparison. When SignalBar=0, the IsNewBar guard is bypassed and signals are recalculated on every tick. UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime are set to last bar date + period seconds for trade timing. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose are input gates that can disable specific trade directions.
python_conversion_notes: MAMA (MESA Adaptive Moving Average) indicator must be reimplemented in Python - it is not available in standard libraries. The algorithm uses Hilbert transform phase calculation; consider using the ta library or implementing from Ehlers' original paper. TradeAlgorithms.mqh handles all position management (open/close with SL/TP, money management) - this must be reimplemented with a broker API wrapper. The conditional MM logic (negative=lot, positive=deposit fraction) must be preserved. The crossover detection logic is subtle: it checks bar at SignalBar vs SignalBar+1, not current vs previous bar, and the crossover condition requires the fast line to be ABOVE slow on the older bar while it was BELOW on the newer bar (looking backward in time via CopyBuffer). Note: CopyBuffer with SignalBar as start_pos copies from SignalBar backward, so Ma1[0] is the SignalBar value and Ma1[1] is SignalBar+1.
